title: Report: Garrett Nussmeier had cyst on spine during 2025 season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: Garrett Nussmeier had cyst on spine during 2025 season
sources.description: During the scouting combine, quarterback Garrett Nussmeier noted that during the 2025 season, he was dealing with a rare injury that caused him to feel a “stabbing pain” in his abdomen while throwing.
